name: @workspace.sh/portable-bootstrap
description: Bundles a Workspace as a portable folder/archive — manifest, root attestation, and per-recipient bootstrap envelopes. The offline / first-contact carrier for permissions delivery.
_imports_note: Host-conditional builtins — see the same block in @workspace.sh/p2p-runtime.
Under Bare these resolve to the bare-* shims; under Node the map is inert.
This module reads and writes the .workspace folder, so it has to pack into
the mobile worklet. Import UNPREFIXED specifiers here (#229).
